source.title: Milling Tranquility Bloom Bug — first-person split-stack and Warband Bank interrupted batch reports
source.author: Dakkon / Almandris / Reikah / Draggoth

quote: if you try to Mill more than the smaller stack it will stop the process
notes: NEW 2026 March28 FIRSTHAND EXECUTION-COUNT CAVEAT for Tranquility Bloom 236761. Dakkon: multiple milling attempts stop after first with multiple bag stacks. Almandris: a single combine then stops if quantities split bag/bank. Reikah identifies under-20 stack as trigger (20 is NOT reagent batch size). Draggoth describes 1,000-stack plus smaller Warband Bank stack, milling stopping when small stack exhausted (1,000 is an ILLUSTRATIVE inventory stack, not casts). Recipe batch size 10 herbs is separately verified existing mechanics M6 (Method guide). No actual output quantities or confirmed completed-mill counts. Crucial: NEVER transform nominal 1,000 herbs to 100 completed mills without operation log and refunds.
